privacy.retention_text: We keep personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including legal, accounting, tax, fraud-prevention, and security requirements. You may also withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

privacy.security_text: We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your information. However, no system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.monitoring_text: We may monitor platform activity, logs, and administrative events to prevent abuse, detect fraud, enforce platform rules, and maintain service integrity.
privacy.third_party_text: Our Service may link to third-party websites or services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, and we are not responsible for their content or data handling.
privacy.contact_text: For privacy questions, complaints, or requests, contact: support@kode01.com
privacy.tracking_text: We store behavioral recommendation signals to improve relevance only when the applicable choice is active. For guest users, this data can be stored in browser cookies/local storage when analytics consent is accepted. For signed-in users, relevant data is associated with the account only when recommendation personalization is enabled in settings.
privacy.fingerprinting_text: For marketing campaign analytics, we may generate a pseudonymous device fingerprint derived from your browser's user agent, screen dimensions, and timezone. This fingerprint is used solely for event deduplication and fraud prevention within a limited time window. It is not used to identify you personally and requires your marketing consent.
privacy.dnt_text: Our Service does not currently respond to Do Not Track (DNT). When the browser sends Global Privacy Control, we treat it as an opt-out from marketing and advertising sharing. You can also control tracking through our cookie consent preferences at any time.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.what_text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help keep the platform secure and functional, improve user experience, and support measurement and product improvement when consent is provided.
cookies.how_text: We use first-party and third-party cookies. First-party cookies are required for core platform functions, security, and consent evidence. Google Analytics 4, advertising tags, and proactive Zipchat are blocked by default and run only when you accept the matching optional category. Manual support remains available, and chat loads when you open support.
types_list: Essential cookies: Strictly necessary to provide core platform services (authentication, security, and consent logging). Manual support is available on click without loading Zipchat at startup.

Performance and analytics cookies: Help us understand platform usage and improve features through GA4 page measurement and first-party usage signals. For visitors not signed in, these may enable anonymous recommendation personalization.
Functionality cookies: Improve experience and convenience, including preference storage.
Marketing cookies: Used to deliver ads, measure performance (for example Google AdSense), and enable proactive Zipchat for popups, recommendations, cart recovery, and sales or support prompts.
cookies.manage_text: You can manage or withdraw your choices at any time from the cookie settings button. Withdrawing analytics or marketing consent disables the related Google consent signals and clears optional cookies/local storage we can control. You can also block or delete cookies from your browser settings.

gdpr_ccpa.title: GDPR & CCPA
gdpr_ccpa.intro: kode01 is committed to protecting personal data and respecting user rights under the GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Quebec Law 25, and PIPEDA where applicable. This page summarizes how we handle data protection and how you can exercise your rights.
gdpr_ccpa.controller_text: Data controller: kode01, Gatineau, Quebec, Canada. Privacy contact: support@kode01.com.
legal_basis_list: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): cookie preferences, optional analytics/marketing cookies, proactive Zipchat, advertising, optional personalization, and consent-based communications.
Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): account creation, authentication, checkout, payment processing, seller payouts, and service delivery.
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): platform security, fraud prevention, abuse monitoring, reliability logging, and product improvement analytics.
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): tax/accounting duties, compliance checks, and regulatory reporting.
rights_list: Right of access (Art. 15): request a copy of your personal data.
Right to rectification (Art. 16): correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure (Art. 17): request deletion where legal retention does not require us to keep data.
Right to restriction (Art. 18): request limited processing in specific cases.
Right to data portability (Art. 20): request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Right to object (Art. 21): object to processing based on legitimate interests.
Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)): update cookie choices at any time via the cookie settings controls.
gdpr_ccpa.age_text: kode01 is intended for users aged 18 and over. We may refuse, suspend, or close accounts that do not meet applicable age requirements.
transfers_list: Stripe / Stripe Connect (United States): payment processing, onboarding, and payout compliance.
Supabase: hosting, database, authentication, and storage infrastructure.
Zipchat: customer support messaging loaded when you open support; proactive sales/support features only with marketing consent.
Google AdSense (when marketing cookies are accepted): advertising delivery and measurement.
Brevo: transactional and operational email delivery.
Google Generative AI (United States): AI-powered content generation features.
Anthropic (United States): AI-powered content generation features.
HuggingFace (United States / EU): AI model inference for platform features.
Vercel (United States): hosting, deployment, and performance monitoring.
gdpr_ccpa.transfers_text: When personal data is transferred outside your jurisdiction, we rely on appropriate safeguards (such as contractual protections) and only transfer data necessary to provide and secure the service.
gdpr_ccpa.retention_text: We keep personal data only as long as necessary for service delivery, security, legal, tax, accounting, and fraud-prevention obligations. Some records may be retained after account closure where required by law.
gdpr_ccpa.breach_text: If a personal data breach occurs, kode01 will investigate and notify competent authorities and affected users when required by applicable law, including GDPR Articles 33 and 34 where applicable.
gdpr_ccpa.authority_text: If you are in the European Economic Area, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
gdpr_ccpa.ccpa_text: KODE01 respects the privacy rights of California residents under the CCPA and CPRA.

You can opt out of that sharing through cookie controls, Global Privacy Control, or by contacting us. Proactive Zipchat, Google AdSense, and marketing partners remain off without marketing consent.

cli_faq.meta_title: What is a CLI? – Command Line Interface Explained
cli_faq.meta_description: Learn what a CLI (Command Line Interface) is, how it works, and why it matters for developers and technical workflows. Frequently asked questions about CLI tools, security, and more.
cli_faq.og_title: What is a CLI? – Command Line Interface Explained
cli_faq.og_description: Your complete guide to CLI: what it is, how it works, and why it's a powerful tool for modern development.
cli_faq.title: What is a CLI?
cli_faq.intro: A CLI, or Command Line Interface, is a text-based way to interact with a computer, application, or system by typing commands instead of using buttons or menus. It allows users to perform tasks directly through a terminal, often with more speed, precision, and control than a graphical interface. In practice, the CLI is widely used to navigate files, run programs, automate actions, and manage technical environments.

q1.question: What is CLI?
q1.answer: CLI stands for Command Line Interface. It is a text-based interface that allows users to interact with a computer, application, or system by entering commands in a terminal instead of using a graphical interface. The CLI is widely used in technical environments because it offers speed, precision, and direct control over tools and systems.

q2.question: How does CLI work?
q2.answer: A CLI works by receiving typed commands through a terminal or command prompt. The system reads the command, interprets it, and then performs the requested action. Commands can include additional options or arguments to control exactly how the task should be executed. This makes the CLI highly flexible for both simple and advanced operations.

q3.question: What can you do with a CLI?
q3.answer: A CLI can be used for many different technical tasks. Common examples include: Browsing files and directories; Creating, moving, or deleting files; Installing and updating software; Running scripts and automation tasks; Managing servers and cloud environments; Using developer tools such as Git; Launching local applications or services; Checking logs and system activity. Because of this versatility, the CLI is an essential tool in many development and IT workflows.

q4.question: Who uses CLI?
q4.answer: CLI is commonly used by developers, system administrators, DevOps teams, cybersecurity professionals, and other technical users. It is especially useful for people who need to move quickly, automate repetitive work, or manage systems with a high level of control.

q5.question: How do I start using a CLI?
q5.answer: To use a CLI, you first open a terminal application on your device. On macOS and Linux, the terminal is usually built in. On Windows, common options include Command Prompt, PowerShell, or Windows Terminal. Once the terminal is open, you can begin entering commands to interact with your system or software tools.

q6.question: Is CLI hard to learn?
q6.answer: The CLI may seem intimidating at first because it does not include buttons or menus, but the basics are often easier to learn than expected. Most beginners start with a small number of common commands and gradually build confidence. With practice, the CLI becomes a fast and efficient way to complete everyday technical tasks.

q7.question: Is CLI secure?
q7.answer: The CLI can be secure, but it also gives direct access to powerful system functions, so it must be used carefully. A single command can make important changes to files, settings, or servers. Good practices include reviewing commands before running them, avoiding untrusted scripts, limiting permissions, and protecting credentials or environment variables.

q8.question: What is the difference between CLI and GUI?
q8.answer: A GUI, or Graphical User Interface, uses windows, icons, buttons, and menus. A CLI uses typed commands in a terminal. A GUI is often easier for beginners and visual tasks, while a CLI is usually preferred for speed, automation, and precise technical work. Both interfaces can be useful depending on the context.

q9.question: Why do developers use CLI?
q9.answer: Developers often use the CLI because it allows them to work faster and with more control. Instead of clicking through multiple screens, they can run commands directly, automate repetitive processes, and integrate tools more easily into their workflow. This is especially useful in coding, testing, deployment, and server management.

q10.question: Can AI tools use CLI?
q10.answer: Yes. AI tools and coding agents can work through a CLI environment to carry out technical tasks more directly. For example, an AI connected to a terminal can inspect files, run commands, execute tests, analyze logs, and interact with development environments. This makes the CLI especially important in modern AI-assisted development workflows.

step1.description: Sign up as a seller on KODE01. Set up your creator profile, add your brand identity, and get ready to showcase your work to a global audience of builders and developers.

step2.title: Publish Your Products
step2.description: Upload your digital assets — templates, UI kits, tools, or any creative resource. Add descriptions, set your pricing, and organize your products with tags and categories.

q1.question: Is KODE01 free to use?
q1.answer: Yes, creating an account, reading AI updates, and browsing the platform are free. You only pay when you purchase a product. Sellers can list their products and only pay a commission on successful sales.

q2.question: What types of products are available?
q2.answer: KODE01 offers a wide range of premium digital assets including website templates, UI kits, design systems, AI tools, MCP servers, CLI tools, code snippets, and other developer resources. All products are curated for quality.

q3.question: How do I purchase a product?
q3.answer: Simply browse the marketplace, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Payments are processed securely through Stripe. Once your payment is confirmed, you can instantly download your purchased assets from your dashboard.

q4.question: What payment methods are accepted?
q4.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our secure Stripe integration. Additional payment methods may be available depending on your region.

q5.question: Can I get a refund?
q5.answer: Since digital products are delivered instantly upon purchase, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. If you experience a technical issue with a product, please contact our support team and we will work to resolve the situation.

q6.question: How do I become a seller?
q6.answer: Getting started as a seller is straightforward. Create your KODE01 account, navigate to your seller dashboard, complete your profile, and start uploading your products. Our platform handles payments, delivery, and customer management for you.

q7.question: What commission does KODE01 take?
q7.answer: KODE01 applies a competitive commission on each sale to cover platform costs, payment processing, and infrastructure. For the latest pricing details, visit our Pricing page.

q8.question: How do I get support?
q8.answer: You can reach our support team through the Contact page. We also offer a help center with guides and tutorials to help you get the most out of KODE01, whether you're a buyer or a seller.
